name: Qodana
tagline: JetBrains' static analysis for CI, running IDE inspections in pipelines with quality gates, baselines, and cloud reports.
pricing: Community linters free; Ultimate $5/contributor/mo (annual; $6 monthly); Ultimate Plus $15/contributor/mo (annual; $18 monthly); 3-contributor minimum
selfHostedNote: Linters always run in your CI; Qodana Self-Hosted puts the report server on-prem (license requested via JetBrains support).
modelControl: No LLM component; deterministic JetBrains IDE inspections

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Project-model-aware inspections across the whole codebase; no multi-repo or ticket context.

02-rule-centric.note: Deterministic inspection profiles, baselines, and quality gates fully controlled by the team.

03-dual-workflow.note: Same inspections in JetBrains IDEs locally and in CI pipelines; IDE-consistent results are the core pitch.

05-continuous-learning.note: Static rules; baselines suppress known issues but nothing is learned from feedback.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Static analysis only; no sandbox or runtime validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: No LLM/BYOK dimension to be transparent about; flat per-contributor pricing is published.

08-actionability.note: Can auto-apply IDE quick-fixes in CI (fixesStrategy apply/cleanup) for supported inspections.

09-measurable-roi.note: Qodana Cloud trends and Insights (Ultimate Plus) track code quality over time; no DORA/ROI metrics.
